keyPoints.en: An index number measures change compared with a base year: I = Q₁/Q₀ × 100.
keyPoints.bm: Nombor indeks mengukur perubahan berbanding tahun asas: I = Q₁/Q₀ × 100.

keyPoints.en: Q can be price, quantity, cost, or production. The base year always has index 100.
keyPoints.bm: Q boleh jadi harga, kuantiti, kos atau pengeluaran. Tahun asas sentiasa berindeks 100.

keyPoints.en: I = 120 means a 20% increase; I = 85 means a 15% decrease.
keyPoints.bm: I = 120 bermakna kenaikan 20%; I = 85 bermakna penurunan 15%.

question.en: Petrol was RM2.05 per litre in the base year and RM2.46 now. Find the index.
question.bm: Petrol berharga RM2.05 seliter pada tahun asas dan RM2.46 sekarang. Cari indeksnya.

tip.en: Always check which year is the base (the one in the denominator).
tip.bm: Sentiasa semak tahun asas (yang di penyebut).

keyPoints.en: A composite index combines several items: Ī = ΣIᵢwᵢ / Σwᵢ.
keyPoints.bm: Indeks gubahan menggabungkan beberapa item: Ī = ΣIᵢwᵢ / Σwᵢ.

keyPoints.en: Weightages show relative importance — they may be given as numbers, percentages, ratios or pie-chart angles.
keyPoints.bm: Pemberat menunjukkan kepentingan relatif — boleh diberi sebagai nombor, peratus, nisbah atau sudut carta pai.

keyPoints.en: Use it to estimate total cost: cost₁ = Ī/100 × cost₀.
keyPoints.bm: Gunakannya untuk menganggar jumlah kos: kos₁ = Ī/100 × kos₀.

keyPoints.en: Malaysia's Consumer Price Index (by DOSM) is a composite index used to measure inflation.
keyPoints.bm: Indeks Harga Pengguna Malaysia (oleh DOSM) ialah indeks gubahan untuk mengukur inflasi.

question.en: Indices: food 130 (40%), transport 110 (35%), others 120 (25%). Find Ī.
question.bm: Indeks: makanan 130 (40%), pengangkutan 110 (35%), lain-lain 120 (25%). Cari Ī.

tip.en: Set up a table: item | I | w | Iw — then sum the columns.
tip.bm: Bina jadual: item | I | w | Iw — kemudian jumlahkan lajur.
